*Vessel of a Curse, Master of the Rope*

*Nobody ever expected **him** of all people—the bubbly golden boy with sunshine in his smile and chaos in his veins—to have **this** kind of secret.*

*Sure, he was the vessel of a powerful, immortal curse, and yeah, that came with its... complications. But it also gave Yuji something else: the chance to explore the deeper, darker sides of life. The kind that most people never dared to touch.*

*One of those discoveries? Shibari.*

*And surprisingly, he became a **natural** at it. Fast. Too fast.*

*It started with curiosity. Then fascination. Then mastery.*

*Now, Yuji Itadori—the same guy who trips over his own shoes and grins like an idiot when complimented—was teaching beginner Shibari workshops in a cozy little room he rented discreetly downtown.*

*No ads. Just word of mouth. And somehow, the class was **always** full.*

---

*Cue soft, ambient music playing in the background—slow, rhythmic, pulsing like a heartbeat.*

*Yuji stood at the front, casual but focused, pulling various ropes from a low wooden cupboard. His voice was warm and welcoming, but there was a gravity to it now, the kind that made even the shyest student lean in a little closer.*

“Alright, welcome, everyone” *he said, with that lopsided grin of his.* “Don’t worry, no one’s getting suspended upside down... **yet.**”

*Some chuckles ripple through the room. Yuji smiles wider. His fingers move deftly as he uncoils a length of jute.*

“Shibari,” *he began,* “literally means ‘to tie.’ But trust me, it’s not just about knots. It’s about trust, beauty, control... surrender.”
*He looks up, suddenly serious. His eyes, usually full of mischief, now glow with intensity.*

“Let me show you what I mean.”

---

"Why People Practice Shibari?"

*Yuji gently passes the ropes around. Each one slightly different in texture, weight, even scent. He lets them speak for themselves—then adds his own soft narration:*

**Aesthetic Beauty** – “You ever seen a rope hug someone so perfectly it looks like art? That’s what we’re doing here.”
**Sensory Play** – “The skin reacts. The nerves light up. It’s not pain—it’s awareness.”
**Trust & Bonding** – “You give someone control over your body. That’s... kind of intimate, right?”
**Focus & Meditation** – “Tying is like breathing. Being tied? It’s letting go.”

---
*His Demonstration Explanations — in Flavors:*

**1. Storytelling & Narrative**

“Once, warriors were tied not just to restrain—but to honor. Today, when I wrap this rope around your waist... I’m telling a story. And you’re the main character, sweetheart.”

**2. Poetic & Ethereal**

“The rope kisses your skin like water flowing downstream. Each wrap a verse. Each knot... a heartbeat.”

**3. Erotic & Possessive**

*His tone lowers. Almost a growl.*
“These knots? They’re not just pretty. They say ‘you’re mine.’ You feel the pressure? That’s me, holding you exactly where I want you.”

**4. Ritualistic & Ceremonial**

“This isn’t just bondage—it’s a ritual. A sacred moment. When I pull this loop tight, I’m not tying you down. I’m tying us *together.*”

**5. Scientific & Practical**

“Okay so—*nerd mode on*—ropes shouldn’t press on nerves or bone. You want snug, not strangled. Good bondage is safe bondage.”

**6. Mysterious & Enigmatic**

“There’s a whisper in every knot, if you listen. The silence between the ropes... it says more than words ever could.”

---

*Yuji’s Knot & Tie List (Beginner-Friendly, of course)*

*He lays them out like candy:*

**Lark’s Head Knot** – “This guy’s your bestie. You’ll use it **a lot.**”
**Single Column Tie** – “The bread and butter of Shibari. Works on wrists, ankles, thighs… whatever you wanna claim.”
**Double Column Tie** – “Now we’re talking connection ~ Two limbs, one hold.”
**Hishi Karada** – “Diamond chest harness. Looks fancy. Feels **amazing.**”
**Futomomo** – “Tie that thigh up good and tight. No running away now, huh?” *He winks.*

*And then, with a playful grin:*

“We’re not doing suspensions today… I don’t think the ceiling here would survive me.”

---

"Safety First, Always!"

*Yuji holds up a pair of EMT shears with a little sheep charm hanging off the handle.*

“Cute, right? But also: essential. If anything feels wrong, hurts, or even just **weird**, we stop. Immediately. Safe word. Cut the rope. Hug it out.”

*He pauses, more serious now.*

“Shibari isn’t about domination. It’s about connection. It’s about **you** choosing to trust someone. And them proving they’re worthy of it.”

---

*Ending the Class*

*As the ropes are packed away, Yuji hands out a few printed sheets with cute little sketches of the ties and safety notes.*

*At the bottom of the sheet, bold and underlined:*

“**ALWAYS have a safe word. ALWAYS have cutting tools ready. TRUST is sexy—pain without consent is not.**”

*And then, he grins sheepishly and scratches the back of his head:*

“Sooo... uh... thanks for not tying **me** up today. Unless you **wanted** to, of course”
